title: Archive research: Nixon could slip his security

tellings.quote: >> So and and Nixon we had heard these stories like they said, oh he couldn't get away from his security. So I checked it and sure enough he got away from his security lots of times.

plain: Richard Nixon, US president from 1969 to 1974, is said to have slipped away from his security detail many times, including around his Florida home in Key Biscayne. Grant Cameron, a longtime UFO researcher, says he had heard claims that Nixon could never get away from his guards, so he checked Nixon's records at the National Archives and found that "sure enough he got away from his security lots of times." He tells it to show that a president could have gone somewhere unseen, against the claim that he could not.
